newsitem.title: USA: Amerada Hess in line with forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Amerada Hess in line with forecasts.

text.p: Amerada Hess Corp shares were 9/16 higher at 56-1/16 after the company reported adjusted earnings per share of $0.27, compared with analyst expectations of $0.30 per share.
The stock had been as high as 56-5/8.
The company's refining and marketing division made a profit of $3.0 million.

"The company will have a lot of drilling in the third quarter and expenses were also higher in this quarter," said Eugene Nowak, analyst at ABN AMRO First Chicago Corp. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
